metadata.description: Liquid Co-Invest plugins for Cursor and Grok.

plugins.name: co-invest
plugins.description: Research and trade crypto, equities, commodities, indices and prediction markets on Liquid without leaving Cursor. Live prices, positioning, news, earnings and fundamentals; your portfolio, orders and history; trailing stops and paper trading. Orders are placed when you ask for them, or within an automation limit you set.

plugins.name: co-invest-grok
plugins.description: Research and trade crypto, equities, tokenized stocks, commodities, indices and prediction markets on Liquid from Grok. Live prices, positioning, news, earnings and fundamentals; your portfolio, orders and history; trailing stops and paper trading. Every order is previewed and placed only after you approve it in chat.
